instances.html:
Bike Chain Repair

Hey user_name, here's the quick fix for a slipped chain.

  1. Stop pedaling and shift to the smallest chainring and smallest rear cog.
  2. Lift the chain onto the teeth of the chainring.
  3. Slowly pedal forward while shifting up to a middle gear.
  4. Check chain tension and lubricate if needed.
Pro tips

If it keeps happening, your chain might be stretched. A chain checker can tell you in seconds.

Ride safe out there.
